title: Dilation transfers a planar constant-density piece of an integer multiplicity cone
statement: Let P ∈ ℕ and let C ∈ 𝒟₂(ℝ^P) be integer multiplicity and a cone. Let Q be a linear subspace of ℝ^P, x ∈ ℝ^P, k ∈ ℕ, s > 0 and ε ∈ ℝ. Suppose spt C ∩ B_ε(s⁻¹x) = Q ∩ B_ε(s⁻¹x) and HasMassDensity C y k for every y ∈ spt C ∩ B_ε(s⁻¹x). Then spt C ∩ B_{sε}(x) = Q ∩ B_{sε}(x), and HasMassDensity C y k for every y ∈ spt C ∩ B_{sε}(x).
lean_statement: ∀ (P : ℕ) (C : GeometricCurrentOn (univ : Set (Euclid P)) 2) (Q : Submodule ℝ (Euclid P)) (x : Euclid P) (k : ℕ) (s ε : ℝ), IsIntegerMultiplicity C → IsConeCurrent C → 0 < s → C.support ∩ ball (s⁻¹ • x) ε = (Q : Set (Euclid P)) ∩ ball (s⁻¹ • x) ε → (∀ y ∈ C.support, y ∈ ball (s⁻¹ • x) ε → HasMassDensity C y k) → C.support ∩ ball x (s * ε) = (Q : Set (Euclid P)) ∩ ball x (s * ε) ∧ ∀ y ∈ C.support, y ∈ ball x (s * ε) → HasMassDensity C y k
